title: After 9,000 Trades, This Is Still My Most Profitable 0DTE Strategy
summary: Theta Profits host Yona ('John') interviews himself about his 0DTE 'break-even' iron condor on SPX (a.k.a. MEIC) — selling delta-balanced condors roughly hourly all day with each side stopped at the full condor premium, so a one-side stop is ~break-even and only the ~8% double-stops lose. He claims 9,000+ trades over ~5 years at ~40% win rate, 0.28% net profit per trade, but discloses no separable account return. Write-up: strategies/zerodte_breakeven_iron_condor.md (conviction 2/5).
